name: Paper Atlas
description: Storybook, curious, grand. Every shape is cut paper on aged parchment (a light paper edge and a soft drop shadow), maps with crimson routes, gold date ribbons, wax seals, simple period figures, captions on torn paper strips.
best_use_cases: History told through maps and places
Grand historical events: fires, voyages, cities
style: Cut paper on aged parchment with crimson routes and gold ribbons
